story.originalTitle: Max Verstappen: Red Bull still lacking grip and balance after F1 Dutch GP sprint qualifying
story.summaryEn: Max Verstappen qualified only sixth for the sprint race at Zandvoort after a disappointing practice session in which he complained of poor gearshifts, low grip and oversteer, and he said the car still lacks grip and balance after sprint qualifying.
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘：F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛后，红牛仍然缺乏抓地力和平衡
马克斯·维斯塔潘在赞德沃特举行的F1冲刺赛排位中获得第六名，此前练习赛表现令人失望，他仅列第11快
在选定荷兰大奖赛作为宣布自己至少留队红牛至2030年的场地之后，马克斯·维斯塔潘在赞德沃特的F1赛道首日经历了喜忧参半的一天。
在唯一一次练习赛中，维斯塔潘抱怨换挡质量差——这是该车今年的常见问题——以及抓地力不足和转向过度的平衡问题，他最终以异常低的第11快完赛，落后于做出最快圈速的梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利1.376秒。
在冲刺排位赛之前，通过调整赛车设置，情况发生了变化——他成功进入前十名决胜轮（shootout），最终排位第六，排在了刘易斯·汉密尔顿的法拉利前面。
“我想我们比一辆（领先集团的）赛车排位成绩更好，”他在排位赛结束后接受F1电视（F1 TV）采访时说，“只是有点难找到抓地力和平衡。我的意思是，相比第一次自由练习已经前进了一步。
“当然，要想排名再靠前一些，还欠缺一点点。我们需要弄清楚明天能在平衡方面做些什么。真的就是要找到更多一点的抓地力——在平衡和抓地力上有所提升，缩小（与领先车手们的）差距。”
在承诺长期效力红牛之后，维斯塔潘失去了些许向车队挥舞那根无形鞭子的能力——就像过去他常常做的那样，当时关于他可能转投其他车队的可信传闻一直悬而未决。合同是用来打破的，但不同于亚马逊（Amazon）的购物订单，合同并没有30天无理由退货期。
维斯塔潘言论的内容和他那种认命的语气表明，他只是打算继续应付下去。红牛在过往的大奖赛周末中确实有过一夜之间大幅改进调校的先例——但与往年不同的是，这次的改进幅度不足以让赛车真正具备争夺比赛胜利的实力。
考虑到部分性能提升来自赛道状态的改善——尽管这对所有车手都是一样的——维斯塔潘在第一次自由练习和冲刺赛排位赛第一节（SQ1）之间找到了刚超过0.7秒的提升，做出了1分13.585秒的成绩。在那个阶段中，他的代打车队友劳森稍微更快，做出了1分13.420秒。
但随着赛道抓地力在冲刺赛排位赛第二节（SQ2）中进一步提升，劳森的1分13.136秒成绩不足以晋级冲刺赛排位赛第三节（SQ3）。维斯塔潘的1分12.745秒排名第八，落后于迈凯伦、梅赛德斯和法拉利的车手们，以及驾驶阿尔派加斯利的身后。
尽管维斯塔潘在冲刺赛排位赛第三节（SQ3）中又找到了相当可观的一段时间，以1分12.094秒拿下冲刺赛发车位的第六名——但他落后拉塞尔的杆位成绩0.527秒，因为除了汉密尔顿之外，所有前列车手都提升了相似的幅度。对红牛来说最不祥的是，从拉塞尔到排名第四的皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦，差距仅为0.099秒。
安东内利排名第五，比梅赛德斯的队友慢了0.227秒，但他在第一个飞驰圈冲出赛道，赛车带着损伤。
至于劳森，他也无法解释为什么在短排位赛第一阶段（SQ1）和第二阶段（SQ2）之间只找到了0.3秒的差距。
“正常情况下你会在排位赛中不断提升，”他说，“而我们在短排位赛第一阶段（SQ1）开局相当强势。然后我们没有像其他人那样取得同样的进步。所以，显然我们会去研究这个问题。今天有很多需要学习的地方。”
“不过说实话，到目前为止我在车里的感觉相当不错。整个排位赛过程中我的感觉还行。我以为我们能晋级，所以很遗憾。”
detailEn: Max Verstappen: Red Bull still lacking grip and balance after F1 Dutch GP sprint qualifying
Max Verstappen qualified sixth for the Formula 1 sprint race at Zandvoort after a disappointing practice session where he was only 11th fastest

Having chosen the Dutch Grand Prix as the venue to announce his renewed commitment to Red Bull until at least 2030, Max Verstappen endured mixed fortunes on the opening day of Formula 1 track action at Zandvoort.

During practice Verstappen complained of poor gearshift quality – a regular issue with the car this year – low grip and an oversteer balance during the only practice session, in which he finished an unusually lowly 11th quickest, 1.376s off the pacesetting Mercedes of Kimi Antonelli.
That picture changed through set-up changes ahead of sprint qualifying, where he made it through to the final top-10 shootout and qualified sixth, ahead of Lewis Hamilton’s Ferrari.
“I guess we out-qualified one [frontrunning] car,” he told F1 TV after the session. “Just a bit tricky to find the grip, the balance. I mean, it was already a step forward from FP1.

“But of course, still lacking a little bit to be a little bit further up the road. It’s something that we need to understand what we can do with the balance for tomorrow. To find a bit more grip, really – a bit of balance, a bit of grip to close the gap [to the frontrunners] a bit.”

In committing to Red Bull for the long haul, Verstappen has lost some of the ability to show his team the proverbial whip, as he has done in the recent past when credible threats of him moving to other teams have hung in the air. Contracts are made to be broken but, unlike Amazon purchases, they do not come with a 30-day returns window.

The nature of Verstappen’s comments and resigned tone of voice suggests he is simply going to get on with it. Red Bull has form in being able to conjure greatly improved set-ups overnight during grand prix weekends – but, unlike in previous years, not quite enough to make the car a genuine contender for race wins.

With the caveat that some performance will have come through track evolution – although it is the same for all competitors – Verstappen found just over seven tenths of a second between FP1 and SQ1 to post a 1m13.585s lap. In that session his stand-in team-mate Liam Lawson went slightly faster with a 1m13.420s.

But as track grip ramped up further in the session, Lawson’s SQ2 time of 1m13.136s wasn’t enough to make the cut for SQ3. Verstappen’s 1m12.745s was good for eighth behind the McLaren, Mercedes and Ferrari drivers plus Pierre Gasly’s Alpine.

Despite finding another respectable chunk of time in SQ3 to claim sixth on the sprint grid – 1m12.094s – Verstappen fell 0.527s off George Russell’s pole position as all the frontrunners bar Hamilton improved by a similar margin. Most ominous for Red Bull is the fact that the gap from Russell to Oscar Piasrti’s McLaren in fourth place was just 0.099s.
Antonelli in fifth place was 0.227s off his Mercedes team-mate but was carrying damage from an off-track excursion on his first push lap.
For his part, Lawson was at a loss to explain why he could only find three tenths between SQ1 and SQ2.

“Normally you'd sort of improve through quali,” he said. “And we started SQ1 quite strong. Then we didn't make the same step everybody else did. So, obviously, we'll look into it. There's a lot to learn today.
“But so far, honestly, I feel quite good in the car. I was feeling OK through quali. I thought we'd get through, so it's a shame.”

relatedItems.originalTitle: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
relatedItems.summaryEn: The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix. The collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week.
detailZh: 凯迪拉克F1以全新汤米·希尔费格系列在美国大奖赛上尽显得克萨斯风情
凯迪拉克与汤米·希尔费格发布了一个以得克萨斯为灵感的五件式牛仔（denim）系列
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——图片由汤米·希尔费格提供
赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计，以及让赛车超越运动本身的故事。
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队及其合作伙伴汤米·希尔费格在奥斯汀美国大奖赛前发布了一个德克萨斯主题的服装系列，这让我们所有人都兴奋不已。
汤米·希尔费格与凯迪拉克一级方程式车队的奥斯汀系列于本周二早些时候开售。但这并不是这两个品牌第一次推出与比赛相关的产品。他们已经在同一城市系列中推出了迈阿密和墨西哥系列，并且还计划在11月推出拉斯维加斯系列。
不出意外的话，牛仔布是这些单品的核心，它们带有镀铬细节和汤米·希尔费格红白蓝配色的V形美国国旗。
男士可以购买基于经典卡车司机风格的浅色水洗牛仔夹克。女士则有一件带银色箔涂层的牛仔背心。一件T恤、一件背心和一顶牛仔帽让这个系列更加让人难以拒绝。你知道还有什么同样让人难以拒绝吗？可以看到凯迪拉克车手瓦尔特利·博塔斯在日落时分向镜头举起一顶牛仔帽，背上印有V形旗帜图案。
你还需要什么来说服你？
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克F1车队——由汤米·希尔费格提供
“在我们的美国根源上增添一点乐趣”
汤米·希尔费格首席设计官李·霍尔曼表示，设计师们从该品牌最受欢迎的两件单品入手。
他说：“我们从 Tommy 衣橱中的标志性单品——牛仔夹克和白 T 恤——入手，并研究了如何以奥斯汀的城市气质为灵感对它们进行重新演绎。”
“关键在于把熟悉的单品赋予全新的视角，同时坚守我们经典美式酷感的品牌基因。”
凯迪拉克一级方程式车队首席品牌顾问卡西迪·托里斯表示，在得克萨斯州举行的这场比赛让两个品牌都有了发挥空间。
“奥斯汀让我们有机会在美国根源上玩得更尽兴一些，”托里斯说，“这是为比赛周末打造的粉丝服饰，但设计上力求在围场之外也能长久穿着。”
汤米·希尔费格是凯迪拉克的官方服装和车迷服饰合作伙伴，车手塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯——博塔斯的队友——也是该品牌的全球男装大使。奥斯汀站是美国车队本赛季继五月初迈阿密大奖赛之后的第二个主场比赛，佩雷斯期待能在离家更近的地方驾驶。
“我们距离能够与前车竞争还差大约一秒到一秒半，我认为我们现在真正需要的是一辆更强的赛车，”佩雷斯在新加坡站后表示。“其他一切都在按预期推进，我相信我们作为一个团队会达到目标。我非常期待奥斯汀和墨西哥，我们的两场主场比赛。
“奥斯汀是车队的主场，墨西哥对我而言将格外特别，在家乡观众面前比赛并迎来第300场大奖赛。那将是一个非常特别的周末。”
凯迪拉克在首个赛季仍在等待它的首个积分。
detailEn: Cadillac F1 goes full Texas with new Tommy Hilfiger collection for US Grand Prix
Cadillac and Tommy Hilfiger have unveiled a five-piece denim collection inspired by Texas
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
The Cadillac Formula 1 Team and its partner Tommy Hilfiger have released a Texas-themed clothing collection ahead of the United States Grand Prix in Austin, and it's making us all kinds of excited.

The Tommy Hilfiger x Cadillac Formula 1 Team Austin collection went on sale on Tuesday earlier this week. But this isn't the first time the two brands have released something in connection with a race. They have already released Miami and Mexico collections in the same city series, and a Las Vegas drop is also planned for November.
Denim, maybe unsurprisingly, is the heart of these pieces, which carry chrome detailing and a chevron-shaped American flag in Tommy Hilfiger's red, white and blue.

Men can buy a light-wash denim jacket based on the classic trucker style. For women, there's a denim vest with a silver foil coating. A T-shirt, a tank top and a denim cap make the range even harder to say no to. And do you know what else does the same? Cadillac driver Valtteri Bottas can be seen tipping a cowboy hat to the camera at sunset, with the chevron flag design across his back.
What more do you need to persuade you?
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac F1 team - courtesy of Tommy Hilfiger
"A little more fun with our American roots"
Lee Holman, Tommy Hilfiger's chief design officer, said the designers started with two of the brand's most popular pieces.
"We started with icons of the Tommy wardrobe – the denim jacket and the white T-shirt – and looked at how we could rework them inspired by the character of Austin," he said.
"It's about taking familiar pieces and giving them a fresh point of view, while staying grounded in our classic American cool DNA."
Cassidy Towriss, chief brand adviser for the Cadillac Formula 1 Team, said the race in Texas gave both brands room to play.
"Austin gives us a chance to have a little more fun with our American roots," Towriss said. "It's fanwear made for race weekend, but designed to live well beyond the paddock."

Tommy Hilfiger is Cadillac's official apparel and fanwear partner, with driver Sergio Perez, Bottas's team-mate, also the brand's global menswear ambassador. With the Austin race being the American team's second home race of the season after the Miami Grand Prix earlier this season in early May, Perez is looking forward to driving a little closer to home.

“We are still lacking around one to one-and-a-half seconds to be able to compete with the cars ahead, and I think what we really need now is a stronger car underneath us," Perez said following his Singapore campaign. "Everything else has been progressing as expected, and I’m confident we will get there as a team. I’m really looking forward to Austin and Mexico, our two home races.
"Austin for the team, and Mexico will be particularly special for me, racing in front of my home crowd and reaching 300 grands prix. It’s going to be a very special weekend.”
Cadillac is still waiting for its first points in its debut season.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯分享了约舒亚·杜尔肯森与巴拉圭总统之间的情感通话
约舒亚·杜尔肯森在成为该国首位测试现代一级方程式赛车的车手后，收到了巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳的电话
对于梅赛德斯车迷来说，这里是关于银箭的最新消息，包括来自布拉克莱利和布里克斯沃斯的F1新闻、车手更新、赛车发展和比赛分析
梅赛德斯分享了巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳给发展车手约舒亚·杜尔肯森打电话祝贺他首次参加一级方程式测试的时刻
“一个非常特别的电话。巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·佩纳确保祝贺乔什第一次参加F1赛事。这对国家来说是一个自豪的时刻，”梅赛德斯在视频通话的片段旁边发布了这条消息。
“这个片段来自一部幕后视频，名为《梅赛德斯内部：约书亚·杜尔肯森的第一次F1测试，巴拉圭，我们做到了！》，这是Brackley团队在本周早些时候发布的。
“这位22岁的年轻人两天前在波尔蒂马奥驾驶梅赛德斯W16赛车，这辆赛车在2025年锦标赛中由乔治·拉塞尔和基米·安东内利驾驶。
“这对杜尔肯森来说是一个重要的时刻，这也是第一位驾驶现代F1赛车的巴拉圭车手。‘传奇！这太棒了，伙计，’总统佩纳在电话中对杜尔肯森说。‘约书亚，我真的很兴奋。这是你的梦想，也是我的梦想，是数百万巴拉圭人的梦想，我们都为你的成就感到自豪。我们梦想中的那个巨大的巴拉圭，就是你。’
Durksen在视频中补充道：“从一个许多人认为我们是一个小国家，也许我们无法做很多事情的国家，到达到赛车运动的顶峰，驾驶F1赛车……我认为这是一个明确的信息，特别是对我的同胞来说，我们被允许做梦，我们可以做大梦，我们可以实现这些梦想。”
我认为在驾驶之后，我甚至更加热爱这项运动，而且这肯定是我想要长期从事的事情。
粉丝们分享了他们对巴拉圭车手的激动之情。
一个粉丝评论道：“对整个巴拉圭来说是多么自豪的事情！加油，约书亚，如果你能做到的话！！！！”另一个粉丝补充说：“约书亚太棒了，我希望他们能尽快给他一个F1的座位。”
detailEn: Mercedes shares emotional call between Joshua Durksen and Paraguay president
Joshua Durksen received a call from Paraguayan president Santiago Peña after becoming the first driver from his country to test a modern F1 car
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.
Mercedes has shared the moment Paraguay's president, Santiago Pena, phoned development driver Joshua Durksen to congratulate him on his first Formula 1 test.
"A very special call. Santiago Pena, president of Paraguay, made sure to congratulate Josh on his first F1 run. A proud moment for the country," Mercedes posted alongside footage of the video call.
The clip comes from a behind-the-scenes video, Inside Mercedes: Joshua Durksen's First F1 Test, Paraguay, We Did It!, that was released by the Brackley outfit earlier this week.
The 22-year-old spent two days at Portimao at the wheel of the Mercedes W16, which was raced by George Russell and Kimi Antonelli in the 2025 championship.

Not only was it a big moment for Durksen, but it was also the first time a driver from Paraguay had driven a modern F1 car. "Legend! That's huge, man," president Pena told Durksen on the call. "Joshua, I'm really excited. This is your dream, it's my dream, it's the dream of millions of Paraguayans who truly are proud of everything you're accomplishing. That giant Paraguay we all dream about, it's you."

Durksen added in the video: "To come from a country that many people think we're a small country, and that maybe we cannot do a lot of stuff, to reaching the top of motorsport and driving a Formula 1 car... I think it's a clear message, especially to my people, that we are allowed to dream, that we can dream big and that we can accomplish these dreams.
"I think after driving, I'm even more in love with this sport, and for sure this is something I want to do for the very long term."
Fans shared their excitement for the Paraguayan driver.
"What pride for all of Paraguay! Let's go, Joshua, if you can!!!!" one fan commented, while another added: "Joshua is so great, I want them to give him a seat in F1 soon."

detailZh: 梅赛德斯解释为何一年多前放弃马卡雷纳尾翼
梅赛德斯副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔透露，车队一年多前就评估过旋转式尾翼概念
致梅赛德斯车迷：来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
梅赛德斯F1车队早在竞争对手将其投入赛道使用之前，就研究过自建马卡雷纳尾翼。但据副技术总监西蒙娜·雷斯塔表示，车队最终决定不采用。
这种旋转翼——当赛车切换至直线模式时，其主翼片会翻转——在当前这一规则时代已成为非常显眼的创新。法拉利最先采用这一想法，并被称为“玛卡arena翼”，红牛也在迈阿密带来了自己的版本。迈凯伦——我们已看到其在测试自己的版本——表示将在未来某个时候让其一战。
梅赛德斯是四大车队中唯一尚未对此类设计表现出兴趣的车队。如今，雷斯塔在车队自己的最新一期《银箭电台秀》节目中解释了原因。
“我大概要说一些我们之前没有分享过的事情：大约一年多以前，我们的绘图板上就有这种翼了，”雷斯塔说。“我们一直在相当详细地评估这个概念，它显然在降低阻力方面带来了好处，但在你操作开缝模式（Open SM）的每一节练习与排位中，也会带来下压力的减少。
“这是我们评估过的东西。这是我们从未觉得在平衡上是最佳整体折衷方案的东西，可以说，所以值得在研发以及制造部件等方面进行投入。但这并不意味着同样的结论永远有效，我们可能会在今后重新审视我们的观点和立场。
“所以我们当然保持谦逊，逐一检查现有的所有方案，评估是否有任何对我们有价值、值得采纳的东西，并让这个迭代过程持续下去。”
梅赛德斯到目前为止在没有该尾翼的情况下依然应对自如。车队以578分领跑车队积分榜，领先法拉利134分；进入美国大奖赛比赛周时，安东内利领先队友拉塞尔102分。
不过，重点是在此前于新加坡站将升级分配给两位车手之后，把新升级带到两辆车上。安东内利使用了新升级，而拉塞尔测试了旧版本。车队领队托托·沃尔夫此后确认，新部件将在美国站出现在两辆车上。
detailEn: Mercedes reveals why it rejected the Macarena wing over a year ago
Mercedes deputy technical director Simone Resta reveals the team evaluated the rotating rear wing concept more than a year ago
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Mercedes Formula 1 team looked at building its own Macarena rear wing long before it was seen running on a circuit by a rival outfit. But according to deputy technical director Simone Resta, it decided against it.

The rotating wing, whose main flap turns over when a car switches into straight-line mode, has become a very visible innovation so far in this current era of regulation. Ferrari was first to run the idea with it being coined the Macarena wing, and Red Bull brought its own version to Miami. McLaren, who we have seen testing its own, has said it will race one at some point in the future.
Mercedes is the only one of the top four teams yet to show an interest in such a design. Now, Resta has explained why on the latest episode of the team's own Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show.

"I am probably going to say something we have not shared before: we had this kind of wing on our drawing board a bit more than a year ago," Resta said. "We've been evaluating this concept quite in detail and it's clearly offering a benefit in drag reduction, but it's also coming with a reduction of downforce in every session you operate the Open SM.

"And it's something that we evaluated it. It's something that we never felt in balance to be the best overall compromise, let's say, so worth, let's say, investing in terms of development and also making components, etc. But it doesn't mean that the same conclusion is valid forever and we might revisit our view and our position going forward.
"So we are, of course, humble, checking every solution that is out there, evaluate if there's anything interesting for us to pick up and keep this iterative process going forward."

Mercedes has managed without the wing so far. The team leads the constructors' championship on 578 points, 134 clear of Ferrari, and Kimi Antonelli is 102 points ahead of team-mate George Russell as they go into the race week of the United States Grand Prix.

The focus is, however, on bringing the new upgrade to both cars after it was previously split between the drivers in Singapore. Antonelli used the new upgrade while Russell tested the older version. Team principal Toto Wolff has since confirmed the new components will be seen on both cars at the American race.
